intent: 별똬리(star_coil) BIND 페이즈에서 오로샤 본체가 보스를 직접 휘감아 조이는 모션. 기존 절차적 코일 VFX(_draw_bind_coil)를 대체한다. 컴패니언 렌더러가 BIND 동안 이 시트를 _companion_pos(=보스 중심)에 그린다.

source_autosprite.remove_bg: default (AutoSprite native transparent output; corner alpha=0, no offline nukki needed)
source_autosprite.prompt: Very subtle squeeze on the loose torso coil band: the two or three relaxed loops cinch in slightly then ease, the snake head resting forward and looking up with its gem pendant hanging bobs and presses gently, gold constellation lines and teal gems flare softly. KEEP it SHORT and LOOSE — do NOT add loops, do NOT stack into a tall tower, do NOT fill the center with smoke, cloud, or white puff, do NOT unravel to a flat ring, no drift or travel. Centered, same identity and scale every frame. Seamless gentle squeeze loop.
source_autosprite.selection_note: v6 (SHORT LOOSE TORSO BAND, 'Bind Torso Wrap' pose) chosen 2026-06-22 per user reference: orosha wraps the captive's MIDDLE in just 2-3 loose organic loops (a short wide band, NOT a tall neat stack), snake head resting forward and looking up with the gem pendant hanging, tail to the side. Fixes v5b feedback ('too neatly coiled / too long'). Live per-stage boss shows above/through; head rests on the boss's chest area. Clean (no white puff). Alternatives kept: v5b tall open-top barrel spritesheet cmqom63l600l5la1fljfuf1ih (too long/neat); v4 closed stack cmqol8jx20075bdb8fh83layn; v5 puffy cmqom18qz008hs6683sspe3vq; v3 cmqojnk0h001k2maghvvj3qgl; v2 cmqnb23zp001g6holc0lu90pz; v1 cmqnavniz00c8r3bejjtcwac7.

runtime_sheet.frame_interval: intended ~14-16 fps seamless loop over the BIND duration (1.5s..3.5s by level)

postprocess.operation: AutoSprite native transparent output used as-is. No Real-ESRGAN, no repack, no nukki. removeBg was AutoSprite default; corner alpha verified 0.
